message.title: A message from Antares
message.body: AI moves fast, remaking itself by the day. I keep one eye on the frontier in Silicon Valley — but as an AI product manager, I've learned to keep the other on the business problem in front of me. It is the compass that keeps the work grounded, honest, and on course. A note to myself, and to everyone building in this moment.

update.text: The new Work version of my personal website is live — yay!
